title: Ordinary p-adic interpolation of modular L-values
statement: For a normalized Hecke eigenform and a prime with unit eigenvalue, construct a bounded p-adic distribution from algebraically normalized rational-cusp periods whose primitive-character Mellin values interpolate the critical twisted L-values, with the Euler root and character conventions specified.
status: As of 9 November 2026: Established in the ordinary scope; \citet[\S9.5 and Theorem~10.2]{manin1973periods}. The repeated September exposition is not a fresh open problem. No unrestricted nonordinary boundedness theorem is inferred.

title: Transcendence of zeta(3)
status: As of 9 November 2026: Ap\'ery\textquoteright s irrationality theorem resolves a weaker property; transcendence is still recorded as unknown in \citet[\S1]{nica2024irrationality}, and no accepted subsequent proof was found. \citet[Theorem~1.6]{lai2026linear} is a recent preprint reporting a weaker linear-independence result; it leaves this transcendence question untouched.

title: Transcendence of Euler's constant (elliptical notebook occurrence)
statement: Is Euler\textquoteright s constant \(\gamma\) transcendental? The notebook\textquoteright s “also unproved” is read with the preceding predicate; the historical attribution is less certain than for zeta(3).
status: As of 9 November 2026: Even irrationality is unresolved in the accepted literature checked; \citet[Conjectures~1.0.1--1.0.2 and \S3]{lagarias2013euler}. Purported isolated proofs in search results are not adopted as established results.
